_purpose: Landscape of biblical-studies journals for the article→verse project (#15): what we harvest, what we could add (OA), and what is closed (metadata-only) incl. access pricing. Promote a candidate by adding it to journals.json. Prices are estimates unless price_verified=true — always verify before buying.
_active_note: homepage/publisher/license verified against the DOAJ journals API 2026-07-27 (except tc: not in DOAJ, filled manually). This is the journal-level metadata the frontend needs to credit/promote the journals we link to.

cheap_access_routes.green_oa: Many closed articles have legal free copies in university repositories — Unpaywall finds these automatically for us; coverage grows over time, so re-running `pdf` later catches more.
cheap_access_routes.jstor_jpass: JSTOR JPASS (~USD 20/month or ~200/yr, estimate) gives personal reading access to large parts of the JBL/CBQ archives; no bulk download, but fine for manual follow-up of specific articles.
cheap_access_routes.sbl_membership: See JBL entry — one membership covers the most important closed journal + JSTOR religion collection.
cheap_access_routes.abstracts: For everything closed we already store Crossref abstracts + DOI links; many verse references appear in title/abstract, so the corpus still links useful closed articles without buying anything.
